fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the access drive entrance with posts or reflective delineators on both sides to make the entry point visible at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can travel its full length without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can reach and move around it without being blocked.
• Keep a clear path on foot between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings.
• Post the address visibly on both the main residence and the detached structure so responders can identify each building separately.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris so emergency vehicles can reach both structures.
• Trim dense vegetation near the main residence to maintain clear space around the building's exterior walls and entry points.
• Identify and mark any secondary foot path or gate that connects to neighboring streets or open areas, so responders have an alternate route if the single drive is blocked.
• Keep exterior entry doors to both structures clearly visible and unobstructed by landscaping.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang directly over or touch the house and any outbuildings.
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that sit directly against the foundation or walls of the house.
• Separate scattered shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot move easily from the ground up into the tree canopy.
• Cut or mow grass within the open areas closest to the structure, especially during dry periods.
• Clear dead grass, leaves, and plant debris that has collected along the base of the house.
• Trim back shrubs and branches that overhang or crowd the driveway edges so vehicles can pass freely.
• Keep the full width of the driveway clear of low-hanging branches to allow emergency vehicle access.
• Remove or thin vegetation growing along both sides of the driveway to reduce the concentration of plants lining the route.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so there is open space between their canopies and the roofline.
• Clear plant material away from the area nearest the water feature so that access to it remains open and unobstructed.
• Maintain mowed or cleared ground around any outbuildings the same as you would around the main house.
